headline: Fitch Ratings Expects Nigeria's Policy Rate to Ease to 18.6% by 2028
summary: Fitch Ratings projects that Nigeria's average policy rate will decline from 27.3% in 2025 down to 18.6% by 2028 as inflation slows while real rates remain elevated.
why: Sovereign credit ratings and macroeconomic projections from agencies like Fitch help investors gauge Nigeria's monetary policy path and fixed-income risks.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Projected declines in benchmark interest rates affect sovereign debt yields and domestic borrowing costs.
